query:
SELECT p.id, p.opportunityName, p.address, p.stage,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requiredInspections ri WHERE ri.projectId = p.id) AS reqCount
FROM projects p
WHERE p.address LIKE '%Sumac%' OR p.opportunityName LIKE '%Sumac%'
LIMIT 5;
